services.desc: The Langston Sunset Two-Ball League is a fun and competitive 6-week, 9-hole team league designed for golfers of all skill levels. Limited to 20 teams, weekly play begins with a 5:30 PM shotgun start and features division-based competition, closest-to-the-pin contests, skins games, post-round food, and drink specials
